reference.neighbors: Download actual DivData begin/end table and Dcell with Z ordering; enumerate corresponding fluid cells on host. Shared actual cell table, not independent geometric-neighbor proof. Dummy separation separately excludes boundary support. No O(Np^2) all-soil search.
reference.geometry: FS/main-force/theta: actual downloaded float PosCell local components plus integer cell differences. Complete rate: actual downloaded double Posxy/Posz. Record maximal difference; do not substitute CPU double-to-float geometry or assume support sets identical.
reference.support: Pair.forward displacement/radius uncertainty computed before kernel/rate comparison. Exclude wholly outside range; require remaining interval fully within [ALMOSTZERO,KernelSize2], otherwise stop before acceptance. No membership error hidden inside a large budget.
reference.C: Reassemble FS3D moment with packed geometry, same J1 double quadrature, mathematically evaluated Wendland and propagated device-factor error. Condition on observed GPU correction matrix; check Ci*M against I with its propagated envelope. No CPU C-bit equality or P2 accuracy claim.
reference.theta: Actual float velocity difference; propagated packed dr/factor through observed Ci and double contraction. GPU uses same main-force float factor when J feedback present; separate double support guard retained.
reference.stress: Rsigmag is float24B while persistent Sigmag is double48B. Propagate actual narrowed volume/float velocity-products/reduction through observed Ci and final float gradients, elastic constants and six rates. Sigma0 or isotropic constant/affine with v0 makes spin contribution zero; no general rotation proof.
reference.rate: Full kw/n*(-theta + k/gamma*(lp-gp.lx+rhow*divAce)); observed GPU C/Ace are conditional inputs. Double geometry with float kernel factor separately propagated. No closed-face or active drainage in these probes, no repeated compression source.
reference.load: Check activation separately from cancellation. budget.definition: uF=FLT_EPSILON/2,uD=DBL_EPSILON/2,Gamma(n,u)=n*u/(1-n*u); positive finite units per output channel, actual receiver neighbor count. No CPU absolute or half-step physical thresholds reused.
budget.packed: Per displacement component, Gamma(3,uF) plus Gamma(8,uD) times sum of absolute stored local operands and size*integer-difference, plus3*FLT_MIN. Squared radius propagates dr uncertainty and Gamma(5,uF) plus host reference arithmetic. Full-double displacement uses Gamma(2,uD), squared radius uses corresponding double count.
budget.kernel: Use analytic Wendland factor (bwen/h)*(1-r/(2h))^3; this is the real-number reference, not a claim that device code divides bwen/h. Actual device bwen*qq*w*w*w/rad has two fast divides (qq=rad/h, final/rad), budgeted at5uF each including final rounding, plus four products at uF each; 14uF before composition is contained in Gamma(16,uF). Shared rad correlation is not ignored by silently equating rounded qq/rad to1/h; separate explicit q/radius intervals remain. Propagate squared-radius and optional float-cast error through positive sqrt and q, then cubic product. Device sqrt1ULP+rounding and division2ULP+rounding assumptions enter these intervals; include small FTZ allowances. This remains a conditional published-envelope engineering screen, not a universal floating-point proof or a guarantee for all CUDA inputs.
budget.accumulation: Propagate pair bounds and absolute-term sums through FS moment, C products, corrected theta, raw float gradient reductions, six elastic rates, and complete Darcy lp/lx/gp/divAce. Final pressure/stress storage float cast included. Each Ratio<=1; failures retained without tuning bounds from results.
budget.source_math_scope: Official CUDA11.7 H.1 tables report fast division2ULP and fast sqrt1ULP for SM>=5.2, based on extensive but nonexhaustive tests, not guaranteed bounds. H.2 documents FMA contraction and fast-math intrinsic substitutions. Actual retained GPU logs show -use_fast_math and compute_86/sm_86. Fixture requires device SM>=5.2; no flags or kernels changed.
